source.authoredBasis: Deliberate false alternatives y=x and y=-x confuse proportional and reciprocal functions. Panels are centered at (-4,0) and (4,0); local axes have identical unit scale and a [-3,3] square window. Reciprocal curves use separate log-spaced segment branches and no x=0 point. Line candidates pass through the local origin. k=±1 represent shapes, not the same quantitative curve for every nonzero k.

notes: Independent actual full PNG view once, batch position 5/7, 960x480; PNG SHA d274f59c6b4b497c0eaa4c480722d322fc8eb45aeaec0675bc6e8763d9ccd339. BOTH full 6x6 square panels inspected. Left k > 0 straight y=x through local origin with dots (-1,-1),(1,1); right k < 0 straight y=-x through origin with dots (-1,1),(1,-1). All four corner ends and dots visible. Faithful deliberate proportional-function mistake; figure pass does NOT make option true. Titles, sign symbols and four English x/y labels clear, no numeric tick labels, complete right/bottom edges and margins. Current spec/render/SVG hashes matched.
